question: When is National Unity Day observed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fri Oct 31 2025 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• National Unity Day, also known as Rashtriya Ekta Diwas, is observed annually on **October 31st** in India.
 
• The day commemorates the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, who was instrumental in the integration of India.
 
• Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel is known as the **Iron Man of India** for his role in unifying the country.
 
• The observance of National Unity Day was introduced by the Government of India in **2014**.
 
• The objective is to promote the spirit of national unity and integrity among the citizens of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**

 
 
• He was the first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of independent India.
 
• Patel played a key role in the political integration of India, merging over 500 princely states into the Indian Union.
 
• He was a senior leader of the Indian National Congress and a founding father of the Republic of India.
 
 
 
• **Significance of National Unity Day**
 
 
• The day is marked by various events, including the "Run for Unity" marathon to promote national integration.
 
• It serves as a reminder of the strength in India's diversity and the importance of staying united.
 
 
 
• **Statue of Unity**
 
 
• The Statue of Unity is a colossal statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel located in Gujarat, India.
 
• At 182 meters, it is the tallest statue in the world.
 
• It was inaugurated on October 31, 2018, by Prime Minister Narendra Modi to honor Patel's legacy.
 
 
 
• **Activities on National Unity Day**
 
 
• Government and educational institutions organize various programs to spread the message of unity.
 
• Public officials and citizens take a pledge to preserve the unity, integrity, and security of the nation.
